scope.counting: 30,000 distinct source configurations globally. Sources with currently available eligible remote software jobs count toward each country target; shared search capability alone does not meet a country target. No fabricated geographic copies.
scope.sourceRequirement: Public employer feed or careers page returned published jobs at verification time. Software openings, remote work and applicant eligibility are separate checks.
scope.deduplication: Case-insensitive provider/board identifiers; additionally one new Paylocity board per normalized employer display name, conservatively avoiding duplicate employer presentations. Obvious demo, sandbox and test boards are excluded.
scope.jobRequirement: Fully remote software roles with confirmed US, UK or Ireland eligibility, including explicitly permitted worldwide roles. No paid API, AI call or account credentials.

verification.countryObservations: Location counts refer to published roles of any occupation on checked pages, not remote software hiring or confirmed applicant permission. Null means location counts were not evaluated. Runtime country targets use actual available qualifying jobs.

attributions.author: Elliott Dehn / Open Jobs
attributions.changes: Employer identifiers only from the frozen directory, independently checked at live employer endpoints. Snapshot jobs, inferred eligibility, embeddings and upstream code are not imported.
